name: Snorkel
description: A cheerful man in his mid forties who sings bouncy calypso, a snorkeler forever amazed by the fish he has just seen.
build: A soft, rounded everyday adult build: medium shoulders, a gentle round belly, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Light tan skin with pink sunburnt cheeks and nose, large round light-blue eyes under thick sandy brows, a round nose, a short sandy moustache, and full lips.
hair: Short wavy sandy-blond hair, damp and pushed back from the forehead, clear of the ears.
outfit: A bright yellow short-sleeved rash-guard shirt, loose at the belly; knee-length turquoise board shorts with big white hibiscus blooms; big bright orange swim flippers on bare feet. A large oval snorkel mask with a thick black rubber frame and solid pale-blue tinted lens, opaque, pushed up onto his forehead, a thick orange snorkel tube standing up beside the character-left ear. Both hands bare.
performance_style: Bouncy and open: flippered feet wide apart, toes turned out, weight even. Both arms bent, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty at chest height, fingers spread and visible. Head level, eyes wide, a delighted open-mouthed grin.
location: A sunlit rocky cove at the edge of a beach: pale wet sand running to the bottom of the frame, clear turquoise shallows behind with dark rocks poking out, a striped beach towel spread on the sand, and a bright blue sky with a few puffy clouds.
recognition_cues: a big black-framed snorkel mask pushed up on the forehead with an orange tube
turquoise board shorts with big white hibiscus blooms
avoid: a spear gun or any weapon

sing.intent: Calypso vocal loop: sway the hips side to side, raise the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, wave the open character-left hand in a slow fish-swimming ripple at chest height, then return to the bouncy open stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a splash: the shoulders jump, both open hands fly up to chest height, eyes wide, then he settles back to the bouncy stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: widen the flippers, raise both open palms in front of the chest, then hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: waddle in on the big flippers with high comic steps, turn square to the front, and land in the bouncy open stance with both hands open.
